# ionhour_check (Resource)

An outbound HTTP check: Ionhour probes `config.url` on a schedule from one or more regions.

Attributes the API defaults carry the same default here, so leaving them out never produces a diff, and removing one resets it. Creates carry an auto-generated `Idempotency-Key`, so a retried apply never duplicates a check. Import by numeric id or `slug:<slug>`.

~> **HTTP checks only in v0.1.** Reading or importing a TCP, DNS, SSL or heartbeat check fails with an error instead of planning a replacement. Read those with the `ionhour_check` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ionhour_check" "public_api" {
  name             = "Public API health"
  slug             = "public-api"
  project_id       = ionhour_project.payments.id
  interval_seconds = 60
  down_severity    = "P1"

  config = {
    url                 = "https://api.example.com/health"
    method              = "GET"
    expected_status_min = 200
    expected_status_max = 299
    regions             = ["eu-central-1", "us-east-1"]
    custom_headers = {
      "x-health-token" = var.health_token
    }
    body_contains = "\"status\":\"ok\""
  }
}

variable "health_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) HTTP probe configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `name` (String) Check name (1-255 characters).
- `project_id` (Number) Project the monitor belongs to. Changing it moves the monitor in place (same id).

### Optional

- `check_type` (String) Probe type. Only `HTTP` is managed through the API in v1. Changing it replaces the check.
- `down_severity` (String) Incident severity when the monitor goes DOWN (`P1`-`P4`). Defaults to `P1`.
- `grace_seconds` (Number) Grace period in seconds (5-60). Defaults to `5`.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Probe interval in seconds (10-3600, plan floor applies). Defaults to `300`.
- `late_severity` (String) Incident severity when the monitor goes LATE (`P1`-`P4`). Defaults to `P3`.
- `mute_notifications` (Boolean) Suppress notifications. Setting `true` on a check is plan-gated. Defaults to `false`.
- `slug` (String) Unique per workspace (`^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$`). Addresses the check as `slug:<slug>` for import and lookups. Removing it clears the slug; deleting the check releases it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (Number) Numeric check id.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is paused (status `PAUSED`). Pause and resume are not managed by Terraform.
- `status` (String) Current status: `NEW`, `OK`, `LATE`, `DOWN`, `PAUSED` or `RESUMED`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339, UTC).

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Required:

- `url` (String) Target URL (http or https, at most 2048 characters). Immutable: changing it replaces the check.

Optional:

- `block_http_downgrade` (Boolean) Fail when a redirect downgrades HTTPS to HTTP. Defaults to `true`.
- `body_contains` (String) Pass only if the response body contains this text (case-insensitive, at most 1000 characters). Plan-gated.
- `body_not_contains` (String) Fail if the response body contains this text (case-insensitive, at most 1000 characters). Plan-gated.
- `custom_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Request headers (at most 10, values up to 2048 characters). Names are sent lowercased; a configured spelling is kept in state. Names that collide after lowercasing and reserved names (`host`, `authorization`, `cookie`, `connection`, `content-length`, `transfer-encoding`, `x-forwarded-*`, `proxy-*`) are rejected. Removing it clears the headers. Plan-gated. Sensitive.
- `expected_status_max` (Number) Highest passing HTTP status, inclusive (100-599). Defaults to `399`.
- `expected_status_min` (Number) Lowest passing HTTP status, inclusive (100-599). Must not exceed `expected_status_max`. Defaults to `200`.
- `fail_after_consecutive` (Number) Consecutive failures before the check goes DOWN (1-10). Defaults to `3`.
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) Follow redirects. Defaults to `true`.
- `latency_warn_ms` (Number) Latency alert threshold in milliseconds. Removing it disables the alert. Plan-gated.
- `max_redirects` (Number) Maximum redirects to follow (0-3). Defaults to `3`.
- `method` (String) HTTP method: `GET`, `HEAD`, `POST`, `PUT` or `PATCH`. Defaults to `GET`.
- `regions` (Set of String) Probe region ids (1-6, see the `ionhour_regions` data source). When never set, the check runs from the environment's default regions, which are recorded in state. Removing it from configuration keeps the current regions; list them explicitly to change them. The count is plan-limited.
- `resolve_after_consecutive_success` (Number) Consecutive successes before an incident resolves (1-10). Defaults to `2`.
- `ssl_expiry_warn_days` (Number) TLS certificate expiry alert threshold in days (1-365). Setting a non-default value is plan-gated. Defaults to `14`.
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Probe timeout in milliseconds (1000-15000). Defaults to `8000`.

Read-Only:

- `ip_family` (String) IP family the probe uses (`AUTO`, `IPV4`, `IPV6`). Read-only.
- `max_response_bytes` (Number) Largest response body the probe reads, in bytes. Read-only.
- `skip_tls_verification` (Boolean) Whether TLS verification is skipped. Read-only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a check by its numeric id ...
terraform import ionhour_check.public_api 123

# ... or by its slug.
terraform import ionhour_check.public_api slug:public-api

# Only HTTP checks can be imported in v0.1. Importing a TCP, DNS, SSL or
# heartbeat check fails; read those with the ionhour_check data source.
```
